One fix, found by the build on the two platforms this was not written on.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **"Make a folder" let a backslash through on Linux and macOS.** The check asked for a slash plus the host's own separator, and on those systems those are the same character, so it effectively asked twice for one of them. A folder literally named `sub\deeper` could be created inside the folder you had open. It never escaped that folder, so nothing was reachable that should not have been, and it was still not what the control says it does. Windows treats both characters as separators, which is why this was green where it was written and red everywhere else.
